tasks_completed.description: R1+R1a+R1b+R1c: Rewrote mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay with 4-arg signature, 3-tier option-lookup precedence (target slot -> same-day cross-slot -> cross-day editorTripData fallback) via new findSelectedOption helper. Card-content replacement uses 3-step precedence: (1) active PLAN card matches selOpt by option_id/name -> mutate in place; (2) PLAN alternative matches -> promote alternative into primary slot, demote old primary into alternatives; (3) synthesis fallback (cross-meal injection) using _synthesizeCardFromV2Option helper. Cost rule RC-12 honored: synthesis sets cost=0 + cost_display='<int> CNY' string, NEVER passes raw CNY through fmtCost. R1a duplicate filter applied. R1b activity replacement uses anchor-card search across attractions/entertainment/cafe/unscheduled_optionals (timed preferred, codex Q3: no synthesis-into-arbitrary-array). R1c accommodation treated as object (Array.isArray dead code removed); day.cover updated from cover_image||image.
Updated call site at effectiveDay useMemo to pass editorTripData (4th arg) and added editorTripData to useMemo dep array.

R2: verified all three CandidatesSidebar groups (Accommodation L2125-2169, Meals L2177-2218, Activity L2231-2270) already consume editor_selections via resolveSelectionLocal with hasOwnProperty key-presence semantics; no edits needed. The sidebar checkmarks will track editor_selections correctly once the merge function produces an effective day that triggers re-render. AC5/AC5b/AC5c covered automatically.

R3 + S1: Added data-slot-card='primary'|'alternative', data-slot-id, data-option-id attributes to all 5 Kanban card render sites (meals at L857, cafe at L946, attractions at L1029, entertainment at L1113, accommodation at L1265). Added data-timeline-entry, data-slot-id, data-option-id to Timeline entries. Added data-day-cover to both cover divs (KanbanView L727 + TimelineView L1651). Added cost_display fallback rendering in meal/cafe/attractions/entertainment cost lines when (cost > 0) is false but cost_display is present (RC-12 SHOULD rule).

R3 (CSS) + AC11: Injected an inline <style> block at App return with rules for .slot-drop[data-drop-active] (green outline + light bg + inset shadow), .slot-drop[data-drop-reject] (red flash animation + outline), [data-slot-card='primary'][data-drop-success] and [data-timeline-entry][data-drop-success] (success flash animation). All rules use !important to override the inline 'background:transparent' on slot-drop overlays (codex F6). Animations defined: slot-drop-reject-flash (400ms) and slot-drop-success-flash (600ms).

AC11 codex F9: Success flash attached to STABLE slot card (data-slot-card='primary'[data-slot-id=X] + data-timeline-entry[data-slot-id=X]) via new _flashSuccess helper at module scope. Called from all 5 Kanban slot-drop onDrop+onClick handlers AND the new Timeline drop overlay onDrop. Flash applied via attribute set + 600ms setTimeout removal. Survives React re-render because it targets the parent card, not the slot-drop overlay which may unmount.

R6 + AC13: Added .slot-drop overlay inside Timeline entry wrappers (Timeline render path around L1882). Uses entry._slotId via timelineSlotId variable (codex F6 — NOT entry._type). DragOver/DragLeave/Drop handlers mirror Kanban slot-drop logic; calls window.setEditorSelection on successful drop and _flashSuccess(toSlotId). Reject animation triggered for incompatible drops.

S2: applyBridge (window.applyEditorSelection) now mirrors the bridge cross-meal option-object copy: when originSlotId !== targetSlotId and both refer to slots in editorDay, the option object is copied into editorTripData.days[n].slots[targetSlot].options[] (deduplicated by option_id). This makes tap-to-select cross-meal selections consistent with drag-drop cross-meal so R1's findSelectedOption lookup succeeds at the target slot.

R1c: Seeded accommodation-1-2 (Wenhua Hotel Kunming, 文华大酒店（武一路）) into data/beijing-lijiang-dali-20260418-100846/days/day-01.json accommodation.options[]. cover_image and image are a data:image/svg+xml;base64,... URI (codex F2 — no external URL). selected_option_id stays accommodation-1-1 so AC7 backward-compat holds on Day 1.

changes.blocker: AC2 Timeline cross-meal dinner row vanishes
changes.root_cause: TimelineView slot resolution (L1717-1737) name-matched displayed entry name against editorDay.slots[*].options[*].name. The dinner-time meal entry with displayed name '晨曦豆花米线' (the breakfast option synthesized into dinner.meals by R1 step-3) matched breakfast.options first via iteration order, so it inherited the breakfast slot id — duplicating the breakfast Timeline row and dropping the dinner row through downstream dedupe.

edits.change: TimelineView.add() for the meal loop now captures the returned entry and tags `mealEntry._slotId = mealType` so each meal Timeline entry carries its source slot ('breakfast' | 'brunch' | 'lunch' | 'dinner') regardless of displayed name.

Slot resolution at the Timeline entry render path now prefers `entry._slotId` over name-match. If entry._slotId is present and within the candidate slot list (mealSlots for _type='meal', actSlots for others), use it directly; recover option_id by name-match against THAT slot's options. Falls back to legacy cross-slot name lookup when _slotId absent (backward compat). Per codex finding 1, also seeds `timelineMatchedOptionId = entry.option_id` BEFORE name-refinement so the restored cross-meal row stays draggable even if editorDay.slots[target].options does not yet contain a name-matched candidate.

Cross-category dedupe key now appends `'#' + e._slotId` when present, so two entries sharing the same name_local but residing in different meal slots (breakfast.meals + dinner.meals after cross-meal injection) both survive. Without this, the second occurrence (dinner-time entry) was being filtered out by the cross-category seenNames map. Codex finding 3 confirmed this change is load-bearing for AC2, not scope creep.

changes.verification: [data-timeline-entry][data-slot-id='dinner'] is now queryable after the cross-meal drag. Build verified via python3 scripts/generate-html-interactive.py — output 361.8 KB, no errors. 18 _flashReject occurrences in template AND in generated HTML.

changes.blocker: AC11 drag-reject has no in-app visual feedback
changes.root_cause: All 6 .slot-drop onDragOver branches set `e.dataTransfer.dropEffect='none'` for incompatible drags and early-returned. Since dropEffect='none' suppresses the drop event entirely, the onDrop reject branch (which sets data-drop-reject and triggers the red flash) never fired. User only saw the browser-native no-drop cursor.

edits.change: New `_flashReject(el)` helper at module scope (next to existing `_flashSuccess`). Idempotent and throttled: returns early if data-drop-reject already set OR if (Date.now() - el.__rejectAt) < 500ms; otherwise stamps el.__rejectAt, sets attribute, and clears it via setTimeout(400ms). Throttling is load-bearing because onDragOver fires many times per second during hover (codex finding 4 confirmed no race with onDragLeave — dragLeave only removes data-drop-active, not data-drop-reject).

onDragOver incompatible-branch now calls `_flashReject(e.currentTarget)` BEFORE setting dropEffect='none' and returning. onDrop and onClick reject branches simplified to call the helper as well. dropEffect='none' kept so the browser cursor still signals 'no drop'.
Same pattern as L911 — onDragOver+onDrop+onClick reject paths call _flashReject.

Same pattern — onDragOver+onDrop call _flashReject. Additionally per codex finding 2, Timeline overlay's onDrop now mirrors Kanban board-to-board branch: if payload.direction === 'board' && payload.sourceSlotId && saveMutations, clear [day:sourceSlotId], set [day:toSlotId], save two mutations with origin_slot_id; else fall back to window.setEditorSelection.

changes.verification: Existing CSS .slot-drop[data-drop-reject] at L2872-2877 (red bg + outline + slot-drop-reject-flash 0.4s keyframe) drives the visual. 17 _flashReject invocation sites + 1 helper = 18 total — matched in built HTML.

findings.summary: Timeline draggability after AC2 fix: when entry._slotId accepted, timelineMatchedOptionId stays null if editorDay.slots[target].options does not yet contain the synthesized option, leaving the restored row non-draggable.
findings.incorporated: Seeded timelineMatchedOptionId from entry.option_id BEFORE name-refinement in slot resolution (L1745-1748).

findings.incorporated: Added board-to-board branch to Timeline overlay onDrop at L1887 mirroring Kanban pattern.

findings.summary: Cross-slot dedupe key change is load-bearing for AC2, not scope creep. Keep it.
No race between onDragLeave (clears data-drop-active) and _flashReject (sets data-drop-reject). No fix needed.
Brunch entries get _slotId='brunch' but resolver's checkSlots only allows breakfast/lunch/dinner. Falls through to name-match fallback. Not a regression for AC2.
